author: Sp4rrkii
body:
I see it fair that my last application got denied as I was unaware of the requirement section for the Builder Application, so i have read and now I'm ready to properly apply.

What is your age? 12 years

What is your Discord ID? Sk33nDhu#5674

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team? I can come on almost everyday of the week for 2-5 hours a day although of course i may be busy sometimes

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder? I think that i am quite a skilled builder in that i have alot of experience on avicus so i know what people like and love, or hate.Also, when making maps, i make them fairly balanced, and add fun factors such as chests with nice loot

Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?
I think its a necessity to test other people's maps and see what i think would be nice to play on.

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors? Straight out, i do not know how to use XML.

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both? I would focus on building maps

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/b22e85958 Truncatis - my first map
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/14b6ce9c9 Mythica
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/a07e167b8 first joint map *proper*



Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.
No

Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?
Because it is fun and Avicus doesn't have as much staff as it used to, aswell as people are getting tired of the same maps being played for weeks on end, and in my opinion, they should be changing the rotations more often, in which i get Builder, that might just happen

How do you think you will help the map development team?I think i will be able to help the map development team by making avicus more like it used to be, really fun and enjoyable, not saying it isnt now, but it is far less than it was. Also,  By throwing some fresh maps into avicus which should make it less boring it less boring and maybe even attract more players
Yours sincerely,
Sk33nDhu
